pages.title: Precision Gyroscope
pages.text: A fused-quartz sphere, the roundest object ever made, spinning in a vacuum. Space itself turns its axis. Carried in the off hand, it holds you steady against Frame Drag and Tidal Strain.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Gravitational Waves.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Lense-Thirring Vortex Core.
